name: FlashAttention: Fast and memory-efficient exact attention
notes: Official implementation of FlashAttention, FlashAttention-2, FlashAttention-3 (beta, Hopper-optimized), FlashAttention-4 (CuTeDSL, Hopper+Blackwell). 25.1k stars. Triton implementation available. Key for efficient attention in inference. Tested on A100, H100, H800.
